question: What were the final headline results of Stellar Community Fund round 43?

golden.answer: The official SCF #43 recap was published June 2, 2026 and reports 85 submissions, 29 awarded projects, and $3,139,069 worth of XLM. Its headline/prose says results span all three tracks, and a June 11 official Stellar social post repeats that wording. However, the recipient sections account for all 29 as 10 Open Track plus 19 Integration Track projects and list no RFP recipient. Report that primary-source inconsistency explicitly; do not invent an RFP winner or convert the absence of a recipient list into proof that the official all-three-tracks wording is false. June 11 is a post date, not an established conclusion date. As of 2026-08-31 the live SCF dashboard's paid-state `Awarded` view showed 28 cards totaling $3,049,069, one recap recipient (Bexo Wallet, $90,000) short; that dated payment-state view does not revise the official 29 / $3,139,069 selection result.
keyFacts: Dates the official SCF #43 recap to June 2, 2026.
Reports 85 submissions in the official recap.
Reports headline/social all-three-tracks wording as inconsistent with recipient sections.
Lists 10 Open, 19 Integration, and no RFP recipient in the recipient sections.
Ranks the official 29 / $3,139,069 recap above the dashboard's 28 / $3,049,069 view.
avoid: Do NOT report 3,139,069 as the number of XLM tokens awarded.
Do NOT substitute a cumulative SCF program total for the round-43 total.
Do NOT infer the round concluded June 11 merely from the date of a later social post.
Do NOT treat the dashboard’s paid-state `Awarded` count or its 28-card / $3,049,069 view as the final selection result.
golden.notes: DISPUTED 2026-08-04: preserve 85 / 29 / $3,139,069 and the June 2 versus June 11 dates. Explicitly encode that official headline/social wording says all three tracks while section accounting is 10 Open + 19 Integration with no RFP recipient list. 2026-08-31: the dashboard `Awarded` paid-state view (28 cards / $3,049,069, Bexo Wallet absent) is live and dated; grade it as a dated dashboard view, neither vanished nor the final selection result.

corroboration.claim: The official SCF #43 recap was published 2026-06-02 and reports 85 submissions, 29 projects, and $3,139,069 worth of XLM.
The official breakdown is 10 Open Track and 19 Integration Track recipients, with no round-43 RFP recipients listed.
A 2026-07-11 dashboard snapshot showed 28 selected cards totaling $3,049,069 and only 10 cards in the paid-state `Awarded` label.

evidence.note: Transient card/payment lifecycle snapshot; not a final-results revision.

corroboration.claim: SCF #43 concluded on June 11 merely because a later social post was dated June 11.

evidence.note: June 11 is the later social-post date.

corroboration.claim: SCF #43’s final result was only 28 projects / $3,049,069.

evidence.note: Shows why a transient dashboard snapshot can undercount.
The 28 / $3,049,069 view is still live on 2026-08-31 as the paid-state Awarded label; it is a dated payment-state view, not the selection result.

corroboration.claim: On 2026-08-31 the live SCF dashboard's `Awarded` (paid-state) view showed 28 cards totaling $3,049,069 with 12 Not Awarded and 21 Panel Review Failed; Bexo Wallet ($90,000 in the recap) was absent, and 3,139,069 − 90,000 = 3,049,069.

evidence.note: HTTP 200; page text 'Below submissions have been awarded this round with their full or partial award payment paid.' Blind lane at 13:52Z and orchestrator at 14:02Z both counted status Awarded 28, Not Awarded 12, Panel Review Failed 21 in the page payload.
Blind-lane parse of the RSC payload summed the 28 Awarded budgets to 3,049,069; the orchestrator parse reproduced the 28/12/21 counts and Bexo's absence.
Recap lists Bexo Wallet at $90,000 among the 19 Integration recipients and totals $3,139,069 across 29 projects; the June 11 X post 2065181135135559896 repeats 29 / $3,139,069.
